scope: Isolated PostgreSQL 17, repository base/v2/v3/lifecycle migrations and RLS, stub Supabase auth schema, synthetic clients only; no production changes
checks: normal save returns persisted ID, timestamp and week
lost-response retry returns original receipt without duplicate
same submission ID with changed answers cannot silently discard or overwrite
submission ID cannot be reused for another client
12 concurrent identical retries create exactly one record
12 concurrent distinct submissions all save with unique consecutive weeks
dashboard timestamp failure rolls back check-in instead of partial save
archived and missing clients cannot submit
RPC denied to public browser roles
server role can execute atomic save
malformed response payload fails without write
cancelled pending ID blocks late in-flight saves without losing editable answers
validation reconciliation returns an already-saved receipt instead of unlocking
12 concurrent cancellation/save attempts settle on one receipt or one retired ID, never both
limits: Not a deployed migration or hosted Supabase integration test; auth functions are local stubs, service-role persistence and RPC grants tested with repository table schema/RLS.
